name: Lambert Shading with Shadow Rays
definition: A shading model that computes diffuse illumination using the Lambertian reflectance model, enhanced with shadow rays to detect occlusion from light sources, improving the perception of surface shape and depth.
summary: Lambert Shading with Shadow Rays is a local illumination technique for isosurface rendering that computes diffuse lighting and casts shadow rays to detect occlusion, distinguishing itself by focusing exclusively on diffuse reflection without specular highlights.
